```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]

jobs:
  clang-analyzer:
    name: Run Clang Static Analyzer
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/rsyslog/devcontainer:latest
      options: --user root

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        apt-get update
        apt-get install -y clang scan-build cmake build-essential

    - name: Configure with scan-build
      run: |
        mkdir -p build
        cd build
        scan-build --use-cc=clang --use-c++=clang++ \
          cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -Denable_debug=ON ..

    - name: Build with scan-build
      run: |
        cd build
        scan-build --use-cc=clang --use-c++=clang++ \
          make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Upload scan-build reports
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: clang-static-analyzer-report
        path: build/scan-build-*
        retention-days: 7

    - name: Log artifact URL
      run: |
        echo "Scan-build report available at: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
```
